observed_value: stored identifiers include carried-forward section/industry headers such as Debt Investments Business Services before the actual issuer and investment
anchor_value: raw SOI rows keep Debt Investments and industry labels on separate header rows; position rows begin with the issuer/instrument

culprit_citations.quoted_text: Artisan Topco LP (8)(10) | Class A Preferred Units ( 7,882,736 units) | 11/7/2023 | 7,883 | 6,602 | 0.2 | %

findings.detail: The bdc_investment_identifier field is polluted by carried-forward section and industry headers such as Debt Investments and Business Services that are separate source rows, not part of the position name.
At least one flagged identifier appears to concatenate neighboring text fragments, as GreenShoot is stored with both 9.27% and a second 9.56% fragment not present in the cited source row.

rationale: Class 2 within-row adjudication. The PP01 flag is grounded: the raw schedule shows ordinary position rows for Lynx BidCo, Artisan Topco LP, and GreenShoot BidCo B.V.; the section labels Debt Investments and industry labels such as Business Services are separate header rows in the grid, while the stored flagged bdc_investment_identifier values prepend those labels to the position text. The error is not that the cited rows are subtotals; it is that the extracted identifier carries classification/header text into the position identifier.
